text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like Winning Ticket is worried about something.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hmmmm… I don't get it… Why do I feel so under the weather?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm eating well, I sleep like a log…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: N-no, I can't be like this! All this thinking is making my brain hurt!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Looks like she's a little exhausted. Maybe I need to revise her race schedule.
